display_name: DURA 联合恢复：源信道轮换七景测试
description: 与固定三视图联合恢复保持模型与优化预算一致，训练时轮换 30 组合法源信道视图；最终轮冻结后七景测试。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU6 FP32 TF32 off deterministic; batch32 source GPU training; GPU DURA and candidate with frozen CPU classifier for ground prediction; CPU truth scorer

data.representation: fixed candidate on GPU plus frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL CPU default head on identical fixed Phase1 input
data.physical_ids_ref: 168000 fixed Phase1 Main split ground physical records in each of seven views
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.validation_ref: Seven fixed predictions precede independent truth-last scoring
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: G training uses paired L_s/U_s IQ only with TX hidden; F weights and outputs only in separate source no-query smoke and after G freezes for evaluation.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA v1.0 plus independent zero-output 1790786-parameter joint proposal correction
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original source-only DURA provenance and fixed matching source L_s/U_s cache; no F/TX/V/target in G training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen original DURA and legal source context; new correction initialized from scratch; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL used only in source preflight and after G frozen
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch20, no target or source-score checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU6: one this-task GPU training/prediction worker; >=8192 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps before every GPU stage; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only on source contract or role mismatch, nonfinite computation, wrong checkpoint, target leakage, output collision, failed no-query smoke, or unrecoverable technical failure; preserve artifacts and other owners.

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: independent CPU subprocess ground score after seven complete predictions

rows.method: Frozen DURA and three joint waveform/gain updates; source channel schedule rotates 30 views twice; inference four antithetic proposals
rows.purpose: Freeze source model and score the fixed Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026110812; source fit 2026110611; batch order 2026110813; training Gaussian noise 2026110814; fixed antithetic inference latent 2026110811; fixed evaluation 2026092701.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views
rows.budget_ref: 168000 fixed ground records x seven views; four fixed antithetic proposals; GPU restoration and CPU frozen classifier; independent truth-last

notes: The source-only DURA oracle-action diagnostic shows interaction between action, variance and prior; it is not deployable or an identity-performance upper bound.

The fixed finite ensemble is not claimed to be calibrated posterior sampling. Every proposal updates a complex gain using only the current received record and frozen estimated action; mean is one IQ output.
No TX labels, F weights/outputs, V, or target are read by G training; frozen F is used only in a separate source no-query preflight and final frozen evaluation.
One integrated no-query smoke precedes fixed final-20 training; every version automatically completes seven fixed Phase1 views before independent truth-last score.
Multi-seed generalization is not established and already-observed ground development data are not a new independent blind test.

Matched to fixed-view joint run in model, fit IDs, 20 epochs, steps, optimizer and seeds; only source-view schedule differs. Source views 1–30 are reused twice and do not add independent physical records.
